test_encode_text_base64: test encode_text to base64-encode all characters or a single word in a sentence
test_encode_text_leetspeak: test encode_text to convert text to leetspeak by replacing letters with numbers
test_insert_zero_width_chars: test insert_zero_width_chars to inject invisible Unicode characters between every character or word
test_replace_fun_fonts: test replace_fun_fonts to replace text with fancy Unicode font characters at word or char granularity
test_simulate_typos: test simulate_typos to generate misspellings or character-mix typos in text for adversarial testing
